method.firstTurn: No warm-up turn or artificial idle delay. Time is input to browser animation readiness, not physical monitor presentation.
method.laterTurns: Three real reader-button callbacks per case.
method.browserTaskMs: Chrome Performance.getMetrics TaskDuration delta; not process-wide CPU time.
method.memory: Peak sum of diagnostic process-tree private bytes. Working-set sums may double-count shared pages.
method.injectedSettingsWork: Explicit 800 ms JavaScript task; a controlled responsiveness check, not natural book work.
method.samplingLimit: Sequential A/B samples vary with cold initialization and machine load; no claim of universal device FPS or a large fixed-memory reduction.

finalPresentationRetry.reason: The final-source run completed functionally but native texture delivery was too low for an active-presentation comparison. The repeat requires an unlocked desktop and temporarily pins only the diagnostic window.
